map.模型 FLOPs 估算器，输入全连接层与卷积层维度估算前向传播计算量(FLOPs: Model FLOPs estimator: enter fully connected and convolution layer dimensions to estimate forward-pass compute (FLOPs), for model compute and inference cost assessment.
map.卷积 FLOPs ≈ 2·H·W·C_in·C_out·K²；全连接 FLOPs: Convolution FLOPs ~ 2*H*W*C_in*C_out*K^2; fully connected FLOPs ~ 2*in*out; MACs ~ FLOPs / 2
map.按输出特征图每个元素所需的乘加次数累计：卷积为 K²·C_in 次乘加、输出 H: Accumulate multiply-adds needed per output feature-map element: convolution is K^2*C_in multiply-adds, with HWC_out output elements, times 2 for FLOPs. 1 MAC = 1 multiply-add = 2 FLOPs; hardware nominal compute often uses MACs, watch unit conversion when comparing.
map.全连接层 FLOPs≈2·in·out·batch·seq(乘加各算一次)。: Fully connected layer FLOPs ~ 2*in*out*batch*seq (each multiply-add counted once).
map.FLOPs 衡量算力需求(时间)，结合参数量评估推理成本与硬件选型。: FLOPs measure compute demand (time); combined with parameter count to assess inference cost and hardware selection.
map.：3×3 卷积, C_in=64,C_out=128, 特征图 56×56：FL: : 3x3 convolution, C_in=64, C_out=128, feature map 56x56: FLOPs ~ 2*9*64*128*56*56 ~ 4.66e9 per sample. Shows convolution compute grows very fast with large feature maps and many channels.
map.FLOPs 越大模型越慢？: Does a larger FLOPs mean a slower model?
map.通常如此，但还受显存带宽与并行度影响；某些高 FLOPs 算子若访存密集会被带宽: Usually so, but also affected by memory bandwidth and parallelism; some high-FLOPs operators if memory-bound get stalled by bandwidth, actual latency needs hardware testing.
map.约为前向的 2~3 倍(反向含梯度计算)，再乘训练 token 数；大模型的训练: About 2-3 times the forward (backward includes gradient computation), then multiplied by training token count; large-model training compute commonly uses the Kaplan scaling law estimated directly from parameter count and data volume.
